topic: Virtual sensor data scope and duplication
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the visibility and uniqueness of virtual sensors and connected inventory across different company scopes. It was confirmed that when accessing data without a higher-level partner user encompassing both companies (e.g., 7863 and 7864), the number of unique sensor records increases, as virtual sensors from one company will appear unique to the other.

A specific technical point was addressed regarding duplicating units: it was decided not to add a fixed percentage (5%) but rather to duplicate data directly from neighboring sensors.
decisions: Virtual sensor data visibility is scope-dependent; uniqueness increases when viewing data without access through an overarching partner user.
